answer: Quorum sampling of graders from established identities with at-stake standing resists sybils. Each task is graded by a random quorum drawn only from long-lived identities holding non-transferable stake, a cipher of honest history; fakes never enter the pool. Sampling is unpredictable, like a lantern sweeping a trusted island, so attackers cannot know which matured accounts get drawn or coordinate a majority. Attacker cost: months growing credible accounts plus stake locked, all slashed when a fraudulent grade is caught, pricier than honesty.
